notes: `אֲנָשִׁים מָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ` → *angry fellows*: the idiom's two morphemes fuse on *angry* under rule 30 rather than leaving `נֶפֶשׁ` unrepresented, and the head is `מַר`, which carries the lexeme.
The last waw is rendered *with*, one of rule 14's listed connectives; the margin's *bitter of soul* was read and set aside (rule 38).
